A '''Bell''' is an item used to summon the [[Ashlands]] boss [[Fader]].

Bells are crafted at the [[Black Forge]] using 3 [[Bell Fragment]]s obtained from [[Charred Fortress]]es.

Three bells are used to summon Fader, requiring a total of 9 bell fragments.
